conditions.displayName: Cloud Run 5xx burst: more than 20 in 5 min

documentation.content:
More than the configured number of HTTP 5xx responses were served by a Cloud Run service within the window. Each service is evaluated separately; services created later are covered automatically. 4xx responses are not counted.

**First look:** open the cloud0 **Errors** tab and use the triage view to see which service, status code and message dominate, then open the sample in **Logs Explorer** (resource type `Cloud Run Revision`, filter on the service named in the incident).
